title: "hpa_quarto"
author: "Tony Shi"
---

We are calculating the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain in humans, pigs and mice.

# Human

```{r}
elevated_human_genes <- sum(57,110,180,83)
print(elevated_human_genes)
```

# Pig

```{r}
elevated_pig_genes <- sum(109,157,31,45)
print(elevated_pig_genes)
```


# Mouse

```{r}
elevated_mouse_genes <- sum(55,185,60,98)
print(elevated_mouse_genes)
```

*Homo sapiens* have the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression (430).
